# Pinned, hashed dependencies for the v2 ingest runner (python -m backend.ingest.run).
#
# .github/workflows/ingest.yml installs this file and nothing else:
#   pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements-ingest.txt
# That workflow holds a database credential in a public repository, so it runs
# first-party code plus exactly these artifacts. pip refuses any file whose
# sha256 is not listed below and never builds a source package. python-jobspy,
# which scrape-jobs.yml installs, must never be added here: that workflow has
# no database credential for the same reason.
#
# The file lists the runner's import closure and nothing more. The direct
# requirements, at the versions the repo already pins in backend/requirements.txt,
# api/requirements.txt and requirements.txt:
#   sqlalchemy==2.0.32   the ORM and every query
#   pg8000==1.31.2       the driver: backend/db/database.py and ingest/run.py always
#                        build a postgresql+pg8000 engine, so psycopg2 is not needed
#   httpx==0.27.0        ingest/core/http.py and every adapter
#   python-dotenv==1.0.1 backend/db/database.py calls load_dotenv()
#   pydantic==2.11.7     backend/services/__init__.py imports openai_service,
#                        and that module loads the pydantic schemas
#   pillow==12.1.1       services/logo_image.py, imported by the pipeline's logo cache
#   nh3==0.2.18          services/description_extractor.py strips markup from descriptions
# Left out on purpose: fastapi and uvicorn (the runner reads the boot-migration
# list out of backend/main.py with ast instead of importing the app), and
# pdfplumber, python-docx and pymupdf (imported inside functions of
# services/resume_parser.py, which the runner never calls).
# backend/tests/test_ingest_workflows.py fails when the runner starts importing
# a package that is not listed here.
#
# To regenerate (pip cannot compute hashes for a resolution): put the seven
# direct requirements above in a scratch requirements-ingest.in and run, from
# that directory,
#   uv pip compile requirements-ingest.in --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     -o requirements-ingest.txt
# then keep this comment on top of the result. Each package carries the hash of
# every file PyPI lists for that exact version, so a runner image that picks
# another compatible wheel still verifies. Review a change to this file like
# code: a new package here runs with the database credential in its environment.
